---
name: demo-script
description: Prepare a reproducible 60-second VenturaGame demo that generates and launches one playable 2D example from a versioned prompt. Use when an executable MVP slice needs a concise demonstration. Do not use when the game loop is unimplemented or requires undocumented manual repair.
---

# Demo script

- Use one versioned prompt and one supported generation path.
- Show generation launch basic control and win or loss condition.
- Keep setup outside the 60-second core demo.
- Include one known limitation of generation or export.
- Avoid implying support for genres or assets not demonstrated.
- Verify the example from a clean checkout before publishing.
